notes.title: Planet Coaster Winter Update
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26098264/55a7386bdd99013973e7874ebb8c333c29b09572.jpg[/img]

Hi everyone,

With the weather getting colder and the holidays drawing closer, it's the perfect time to release our all-new FREE Winter Update for you to enjoy! 

The Winter Update is live now and will automatically become available to you via a Steam update.

This seasonal gift contains the following festive treats – there is something for everyone, so check out the update notes below! 


[b]New Rides[/b]
[list][*]Collider! The winner of our community poll with 41.57% of the votes - a retro sci-fi ride with 20 swinging gondolas on a horizontal Ferris Wheel that rises to an angle of 87 degrees.
[*]Bumpin Derby; a long-time favourite has found its way into Planet Coaster! Give a fist bump to these bonkers bumper cars![/list]

[img]https://forums.planetcoaster.com/attachment.php?attachmentid=701&d=1481811298[/img]


[b]Management Improvements[/b]
[list][*]Macro management features added; in the Attraction and Shops tab you can globally set prices, sync shops and open/close attractions.
[*]There is now an 'All Staff' view, which lets you change their salary, training level, roster, and workload all at once! 
[*]You can now also place multiple staff members of the same type simultaneously in your parks!
[*]Ride/Coaster prestige is now shown on the Info panel and changes with time (initially decreasing and then increasing as the ride gains classic status.) Prestige is also communicated in the form of guest thoughts and notifications.
[*]A recently used tab has now been added to each browser category.
[*]A delete path button makes it that it's easier to change around your pathing![/list]


[b]Three new Scenarios![/b]
Festive King Coaster's Crackers will let you earn up to nine more stars – be sure to think about your ride prestige...


[b]New Shops[/b]
[list][*]Cosmic Cow Ice Cream; get some actual snow cones!
[*]Gulpee Soda; joining the Gulpee family!
[*]Missy Good; donut worry, be happy! Missy Good's sugary goodness will cheer you right up!
[*]Pipshot; a healthy alternative to the fast food goodness – and there's three of them! Pipshot Water, Pipshot Juice, and Pipshot Smoothie are going to blow your guests' minds.
[*]Pizza Pen; get it while it's hot and cheesy![/list]

[img]https://forums.planetcoaster.com/attachment.php?attachmentid=703&d=1481811349[/img]


[b]Winter Theme and Scenery Objects[/b]
[list][*]Snow/Ice Biome; it's getting chilly in your park! Explore this beautiful Arctic biome in Sandbox or Challenge mode.
[*]Snow Objects; create realistic snow-covered areas and build your own snowman!
[*]Gingerbread wall set; we can't wait to see the creative gingerbread houses you can build in-game!
[*]Winter Scenery; decorate your park with a lovely Christmas tree or a carolling choir.
[*]Festive King Coaster is your latest addition to the Entertainer family![/list]


[b]New Transport/Tracked Rides[/b]
[list][*]Sleigh Ride; jingle all the way with these tracked snowy sliders!
[*]Iron Horse; a new transport ride for your park visitors to choo around your area.[/list]


[b]New Coaster Blueprints[/b]
[list][*]Screamer (the American Arrow)
[*]Lycanthrope (Werewolf)
[*]The Hunt (Pioneer)
[*]Frenzy (Rage)
[*]Trailer Blazer (Aethon)[/list]


[b]More – see the build notes for full details. Includes:[/b]
[list][*]Pressing F5 now transports you back into the game rather than the menu. 
[*]Stability improvements
[*]Balance
[*]Bug fixing[/list]

[img]https://forums.planetcoaster.com/attachment.php?attachmentid=702&d=1481811324[/img]


We hope all of you enjoy this incredible, free Winter Update, and we're looking forward to seeing all your winter-themed Workshop items appear. If you want to, send your creations to community@frontier.co.uk with the subject "Winter Workshop Wonderland" and you might be featured on our 24 hour long Festive Charity livestream on December 19!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3HJFQRfxDdo

notes.notes:

As mentioned in a [url=https://forums.planetcoaster.com/showthread.php/18914-Long-loads-on-start-up]forum post yesterday[/url], we are redeploying the 1.0.3 update! 

This will be to address a bug which was identified that caused prolonged waiting times at startup for users with community translated languages active. 

To be precise, this update fixes the languages encoded in UTF8 / multibyte characters (such as Chinese, Japanese and Korean). Which will fix the extended delays seen at startup of the game. 

The details of the update were posted yesterday and available here: https://forums.planetcoaster.com/showthread.php/18894

notes.title: Planet Coaster, Holiday Update
notes.notes:
Greetings coaster friends,

We've only just released Planet Coaster and we hope that you're all having a blast playing the game, but we've already got some big news for you!

Since the festive month of December is soon upon us, we are preparing a special holiday update for you! This free content update will be like an early Christmas present for our beloved community. It's going to be filled with a variety of goodies, of which we'll be sharing the details closer its release time. However, one special feature is something that we want [I]YOU[/I] to decide!

You, as a community, get to vote on which new flat ride will be included in this holiday update. We've narrowed your options down to these four, and we can't wait to see which one will be your favourite pick!

[LIST]
[*][B]Classic Ferris Wheel[/B] - a theme park trademark, standing 30m tall and holding 20 gondolas.
[*][B]Sizzer[/B] -  Spinning, suspended grasscutter ride that whips you in every direction!
[*][B]Trihorse[/B] - A three-armed, rotating, swinging, and suspended vintage ride, raising its arms up to an angle of 40 degrees.
[*][B]Collider[/B] - Retro sci-fi ride with 20 swinging gondolas on a horizontal Ferris Wheel that rises to an angle of 87 degrees.
[/LIST]

[url=https://forums.planetcoaster.com/showthread.php/17308-Planet-Coaster-Holiday-Update][h1]Click here to cast your vote![/h1][/url]

We're sure [I]Yule love[/I] this holiday update and we're looking forward to seeing your choice of ride, I’m sure it'll be a cracker!

Greetings everyone! Today is a very special day to all of us here at Frontier. With the poke of a button, flick of a switch, pure dedication, and love poured into Planet Coaster, we are thrilled to state that we've left beta and are now at v1.0.0 of Planet Coaster. Below are our 1.0 patch notes.

[b]Planet Coaster: Thrillseeker Edition[/b]
[list][*][b]The Planet Coaster Official Soundtrack.[/b] Enjoy an hours' worth of pleasure to your ears!
[*][b]The Planet Coaster Digital Sketchbook. [/b] Let your imagination run wild with the sketchbook!
[*]What's better than the normal Coaster King mascot? [b]The Golden Coaster King mascot! [/b]
[*]Why not show off your wares, your guests have the [b]Golden Avatar baseball hat unlocked! [/b][/list]

[b]Planet Coaster[/b]
[list][*][b]Final Steam achievements. [/b] There's 31 of those shinies, build and conquer! 
[*]Steam trading cards. 
[*]All 12 scenarios.
[*][b]Tutorial videos. [/b] Whether you are new to the genre or just need a refresher, we have you covered with our tutorials!
[*]Stability improvements. 
[*]Further tweaks to texture streaming system.[/list]

As always, thank you for your continued feedback and support, we are truly grateful for you joining us for the ride! 

For those looking for file sizes to the update, if you were on 0.9.6, the update is about 410MB. If you are just getting started, the game is about 5.3GB.

notes.title: Planet Coaster Beta Update #4!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26098264/0c48a56309e2b8ca7081ef2ac15f9a3ec358a3cf.jpg[/img]We’re so happy that you’re all enjoying the beta! As we move even closer to Planet Coaster’s release date (only 3 days away now... exciting!), the developers have been working around the clock and we’re super excited to be revealing some final features into the game – it’s update time! 
 
- [B]New rides: Rolling River, Invincible, Chair-O-Plane[/B]
These three new attractions are the perfect addition to your parks; you can add the stunning new Rolling River water ride, create a new epic coaster with the Invincible, or add a more gentle touch with the Chair-O-Plane! How exciting!
- [B]BALLOONS!![/B] The latest addition to the Planet Coaster shops is an all-time favourite, balloon shop Loony Blooons! We can’t wait to see your guests walking around with their colourful souvenirs. And even better, each balloon is on a string!
- [B]More Shop news[/B]: Themed hats, mayonnaise for Monsieur Frites
 We have also added a variety of hats to be purchased in the Hat Shops, themed to Western, Sci-fi, and Fantasy; so your guests will have loads more options for funky headwear! Lastly, your guests can now choose to top their fries with... mayonnaise (YES, HOLLAND REPRESENT!), to give them the best of flavours at Monsieur Frites shops.
- [B]Two new entertainers![/B]
You’ve already had some sneak previews of the two last additions to the park staff, but we’re so happy they are finally ready to join the family: give a warm welcome to Miss Elly, our Western hot shot patrolling the grounds, and Tiki Chicken, the fiery, community-created flavour maker. 
- [B] Help System[/B]: to... help!
- [B]Scenario balancing[/B] to Pirate Battles and Monolith
Thanks to your valuable feedback over the past few days of beta, we have made some balancing changes to the two Beta Scenarios even further; try your hand at them again and see if you can still pass them both with three stars!
-   [B]UI flow improvements[/B]
The panel in the info panel and park management will now remember the last tab you were on; so you will not have to search for your active tabs again.
-   [B]More lights[/B] hooked up to Coaster Trigger system
Get the most of triggered events with even more lighting options to spruce up your coaster ride!
-  [B] VIP Staff Pass now supports facial hair[/B]
Get all the beards going this Movember!
-   [B]Polish, QOL and Balancing[/B] - more of this 
-   [B]More optimisations[/B]: the team has been working hard over the last few weeks to get framerate up even further for a smooth experience, and today's update has the latest fruits of their labours.
-   [B]Stability and compatibility improvements[/B]
-   [B]Boids[/B]: Flocking Pigeons!
 
And last but not least, by popular demand, your [B]PARK AREA IS NOW OVER 2.5 TIMES BIGGER THAN BEFORE[/B]! As a result of the team's hard work on optimisations, they have increased your park sizes. You’ll have even more space to put down rides, build crazy coasters, and craft intricate landscapes your guests will absolutely love! 
 
You may see further updates for fixes before launch. Don’t forget, the final launch update will include the additional scenarios (with release balancing) as well as Steam achievements and trading cards!

Planet Coaster is an important release for us, not just because we’re self-publishing the games that we love, but also because of the incredible community we have had the pleasure of being a part of over the past few months, who are equally passionate about the game, give us constant inspiration and feedback, and have helped us shape the game along the way. Every supportive post, share of your great content and kind word really does help spur the team on and is a vital part of the development of Planet Coaster. Thank you so so much for joining us for the ride, we can’t wait for November 17.

notes.title: Steam Workshop update regarding your Blueprints
notes.notes:
Hi all, as seen from our official forums, an update to the Steam Workshop. Please see the news quote below. :)

[quote]We’re getting close to Planet Coaster’s launch on November 17, 2016 and we’re really excited to see everyone playing and contributing to the Steam workshop and here on our forums! With our Beta fast approaching as well, we have a small but important update in regards to the Steam Workshop as we move toward these upcoming milestones.
 
Items posted to the Workshop in the Alpha version of Planet Coaster will [U]NOT[/U] be available in the full release of the game, but there is a super easy way to save your Workshop items locally and transfer them with you into Beta.
 
If you have already saved your blueprint locally, you can skip this! If you don’t, here’s how you can do it:
[OLIST]
[*]Go to your Steam Library, find Planet Coaster Alpha and click on “Browse The Workshop” button
[*]Click on Your Files > Files You’ve Posted
[*]Subscribe to the items you haven’t got local blueprints of and wait for Steam to download them
[*]Load up a new, empty park on any available level
[/OLIST]


Now you’re ready to start saving these items locally; once your game has loaded, continue with the following steps to preserve your amazing creations for the Beta:
[OLIST]
[*]Place the workshop item in your park
[*]Using the multi-select tool, select the workshop item you’ve just placed
[*]On the top-right, click on the “Save Item As Blueprint” button
[*]Give your blueprint a title and description
[/OLIST]


That’s it! You’ve saved your blueprint locally and are ready to go. When the Beta/full release of Planet Coaster is released, you’ll be able to access the locally saved blueprint from the “My Blueprints” tab in Sandbox Mode – which you’ll be able to upload at your convenience to the Beta/full release Workshop. Also bear in mind that the current Alpha will be available to play a little after the Beta has gone live, so you don't have to rush to save your Workshop items.

Have a nice evening,
Bo[/quote]
